mainEntity.name: Can I install a basement door myself, or should I hire a pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but only if the opening is simple and you are comfortable with measuring, leveling, anchoring, and sealing. If the foundation is uneven, the door is oversized, or water intrusion is already present, professional installation is the safer option.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY is possible for a simple, well-sized opening. If the frame is out of square, the foundation is uneven, or there’s any water problem, hire a professional to avoid a poor seal or fit.
